units.source_text: 但望俯察我心，亦可聊慰相思。”

en.t: I only hope that you will kindly understand my heart; that alone may somewhat comfort my longing.

units.source_text: 这封信系在一根异常枯槁的小竹枝上，竹叶上的霜也不拂落，连那个送信使者也形容枯槁。

en.t: This letter was tied to an unusually withered little bamboo branch; the frost on its leaves had not even been brushed away, and even the messenger who brought it looked gaunt and wasted.

units.source_text: 还有式部卿亲王的儿子左兵卫督，即紫姬之兄，因为经常出入于六条院，自然详知玉鬘入宫之事。

en.t: There was also the Captain of the Left Division of Palace Guards, son of Prince Shikibukyo and elder brother of Lady Murasaki; because he often came and went at the Rokujo estate, he naturally knew the details of Tamakazura's entry into court.

units.source_text: 为此不胜悲愤，信中诉恨之言甚多。

en.t: For this reason he was overcome with grief and anger, and his letter contained many words of bitter complaint.
